# pools.haruhime.moe

> Source for https://pools.haruhime.moe (in beta), where you build an osu! tournament mappool: anyone signs in with osu! and makes pools with co-editors, searching every osu! map under a mod (star rating, AR, OD, BPM and length with that mod, from the hinai mirror), checking the pool against the content rules for officially supported tournaments, and seeing where each map was played before; an unlisted or public pool with maps gets its own pack on packs.haruhime.moe, kept in step with it. Past tournament pools are there as reference: pool search, a search of every osu! map (leaving out sets officially supported tournaments can't use), search of the maps played in pools, and every tournament a map was played in. Past pools come from otdb's export (by Sheppsu), tournament hosts and community members; an importer fills a MongoDB database from otdb's export, admins add the pools hosts and community members send (in the Discord server or by email), and every past pool gets a plain pack on packs.haruhime.moe. Admins are listed by osu! ID and moderate built pools. It never hosts beatmap files. Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript 7 and MongoDB, run with Bun. MIT license. The live site serves its own llms.txt at https://pools.haruhime.moe/llms.txt; this file covers the repository.

## Site

- [llms.txt on the live site](https://pools.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): the pages, every current past pool, every public built pool, the most used maps and the legal pages
- [pools.haruhime.moe](https://pools.haruhime.moe/): the live site

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe#readme): what pools does, its features, stack and the shared packages it uses
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions, data rules and file layout for AI coding agents
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, environment variables, tests, the importer and the checks a PR must pass
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability

## Source

- [src/utils/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/tree/main/src/utils): the pure code: name parsing, fingerprints, import planning, usage, the pack input, search params and queries
- [src/lib/import-runner.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/lib/import-runner.ts): the import run
- [src/services/add-pool.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/services/add-pool.ts): an admin adding a host or community pool through the importer's planner
- [src/lib/map-search.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/lib/map-search.ts) and [src/services/all-maps.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/services/all-maps.ts): searching every osu! map and judging each set
- [src/models/Pool.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/models/Pool.ts): the past pool record's fields and indexes
- [src/models/BuiltPool.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/models/BuiltPool.ts) and [src/schemas/built-pool.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/schemas/built-pool.ts): a built pool's fields, limits and indexes
- [src/components/builder/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/tree/main/src/components/builder) and [src/hooks/usePoolEditor.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/hooks/usePoolEditor.ts): the pool editor (slot targets and templates, slot notes, map previews, undo, export, recent changes, drag and drop) and the map browser
- [src/utils/built-ops.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/utils/built-ops.ts) and [src/utils/built-plan-ops.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/utils/built-plan-ops.ts): what each editor op does (shared by the server and the browser), and [src/utils/undo.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/utils/undo.ts): the inverses undo sends
- [src/services/built-pool-activity.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/services/built-pool-activity.ts): the built pools' activity log (owner and editors only, last 200 per pool, 180 days)
- [src/services/built-pack-sync.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/services/built-pack-sync.ts): keeping a built pool's pack on packs in step
- [src/utils/llms-txt.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/utils/llms-txt.ts): builds the live /llms.txt
- [.env.example](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe/blob/main/.env.example): every environment variable, with what it's for

## Elsewhere

- [@haruhimemoe/pool](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pool): the mappool shape and the pack key codec
- [@haruhimemoe/osu](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu): osu! API v2 shapes and the server client
- [@haruhimemoe/hinai](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/hinai): the client for the hinai beatmap mirror
- [@haruhimemoe/compliance](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/compliance): the content rules for officially supported tournaments
- [@haruhimemoe/ui](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui): the React components and theme the site is built from
- [@haruhimemoe/brand](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/brand): generates the logos, icons and link preview
- [packs.haruhime.moe](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe): the pack builder each pool opens in, and where shared built pools get their packs
